lifecycle_contract.output_bound: checked frame, record and worst-case raw payload bound
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: stable tscb_status_v1 including INVALID_ARGUMENT, DST_TOO_SMALL, UNSUPPORTED and CODEC_ERROR
lifecycle_contract.reset: ABI reset clears object state and native timing while preserving enablement

stream_components.outer_container: 12-byte versioned prefix plus canonical JSON descriptors
stream_components.native_header: scheme, dtype width, row/column counts, block size, error bound and XOR adjustment
stream_components.block_records: kind, reset flag, logical count, exact valid bits, stored byte count and payload
stream_components.qt_state: new predictor and quantizer state for every block
stream_components.xor_state: adaptive XOR state continues across finite blocks within one column
stream_components.raw_exception: non-finite or unsafe-to-quantize blocks stored exactly and fully charged
stream_components.accounting: all outer and native physical bytes charged exactly once; capacities and upstream size estimates are excluded

known_limitations: Serf-Qt and Serf-XOR are distinct AlgorithmIDs and results must not be merged; their predictor/state behavior differs.
Only homogeneous little-endian float32/float64 VALUE UTS and synchronous MTS without validity are registered.
Only a positive finite ABSOLUTE error bound is registered; relative, pointwise-relative, lossless and zero-bound modes are unsupported.
Qt resets per block. XOR preserves adaptive state only across finite blocks in one column and resets after a raw exception; block size and state semantics are comparison facts.
The native timing boundary covers complete native Serf frame encode/decode, not only upstream block calls and not an lzbench-equivalent kernel interval.
Three replayed patches define aliasing and shift behavior, bound prefix-mask indices and prevent input-bit-stream overread. The C ABI shim uses aligned copies for typed access.
The CC BY-NC 4.0 source is admitted for noncommercial evaluation only; redistribution and commercial use require license review.
Streaming, query and random access are not registered. Operation is one-shot, scalar CPU and single-threaded.
Formal evidence covers only exchange_rate float64 at absolute error 0.001 and block size 1000; it is not a universal performance claim.
Formal report evidence does not project raw-exception-block telemetry, so no claim that the real dataset used zero raw exception blocks is made.
LeakSanitizer is disabled under the host ptrace policy; ASan and UBSan remain enabled and fail-fast.
